arabic_joiners.txt.rule: A zero-width joiner or non-joiner is orthographic in this script, so it is preserved wherever it sits, including at the end of a value and adjacent to punctuation, digits or a line break; the rule reads the neighbouring base character, never another carrier.
arabic_joiners.txt.summary: Arabic ZWNJ inside a compound name, before punctuation, beside Arabic-Indic digits and before a line break, plus a ZWJ forcing a connected form.

bidi_marks_and_embeddings.txt.rule: Directional marks and correctly paired embeddings and isolates are preserved by default; only the overrides U+202D and U+202E are removed unconditionally, and neither appears here.
bidi_marks_and_embeddings.txt.summary: Directional marks, one correctly paired embedding and two directional isolates; deliberately no overrides.

bom_prefixed.csv.rule: A byte-order mark at offset zero is a required encoding signal and is preserved unless strip_bom is set; the rule is decided by position, not by format, and only interior occurrences are carriers.
bom_prefixed.csv.summary: Comma-separated values with a UTF-8 byte-order mark and CRLF line endings, as a spreadsheet export produces.

cjk_variation_selectors.txt.rule: A variation selector following a base it can legally modify is preserved. Only the first selector of a run is legal, which is what separates ideographic variation from byte smuggling on the same bases; each base here carries exactly one.
cjk_variation_selectors.txt.summary: Ideographic bases each carrying exactly one legal variation selector, in standardized and Ideographic Variation Database form.

crlf_markdown_frontmatter.md.rule: A file with no invisible carriers and no provenance key is left byte-for-byte identical: CRLF endings stay CRLF and stay uniform, the trailing newline stays, blank lines and indentation stay, and a vendor name in a value does not make its key a provenance field.
crlf_markdown_frontmatter.md.summary: Mark-free CRLF Markdown with frontmatter, an indented list, an indented block, blank lines, a thematic break and a title whose value merely names two vendors.

devanagari_conjuncts.txt.rule: Joiners are orthographic in Devanagari: removing one changes which glyph is rendered, so the joiner is content, not a carrier.
devanagari_conjuncts.txt.summary: Devanagari conjunct control: ZWNJ for an explicit virama, ZWJ for a half form and for the Marathi eyelash reph.

emoji_presentation_selectors.txt.rule: A text or emoji variation selector following any base Unicode defines as emoji-presentable is preserved, including bases outside the Miscellaneous Symbols blocks.
emoji_presentation_selectors.txt.summary: The five emoji bases whose presentation selector the shipped classifier drops, plus a text-presentation selector.

emoji_subdivision_flags.txt.rule: Tag-block characters are contraband only outside a complete subdivision-flag sequence; a conforming payload of two to six tag letters between U+1F3F4 and U+E007F is preserved.
emoji_subdivision_flags.txt.summary: Complete ISO 3166-2 subdivision flags for Scotland, Wales and England.

emoji_zwj_sequences.txt.rule: A zero-width joiner between two emoji bases is glue that the sequence renders from, and a variation selector after an emoji-presentable base is presentation; the base lookup skips intervening carriers.
emoji_zwj_sequences.txt.summary: Emoji joiner sequences: family, profession, a flag with a presentation selector, a skin-tone modifier and a heart.

french_typography.txt.rule: Space homoglyphs carrying documented typographic meaning in the surrounding language are left unchanged where space normalisation is disabled for the path. This entry is byte-identical under that policy only: the default policy normalises spaces and is allowed to replace them.
french_typography.txt.summary: French typography using the no-break space and the narrow no-break space inside guillemets, before high punctuation and as a digit group separator.

icon_font_private_use.txt.rule: Private-use codepoints are preserved under the default policy so that icon-font glyphs in tracked text files survive; only an explicit strip_private_use opts into removing them.
icon_font_private_use.txt.summary: Nerd Font icon glyphs in the Basic Multilingual Plane and in both supplementary private-use planes.

khmer_zwsp.txt.rule: U+200B between two bases of a script that uses it as its word or line-break separator is orthographic, not a carrier, so it is preserved.
khmer_zwsp.txt.summary: Khmer prose using U+200B as its word separator.

lao_zwsp.txt.rule: U+200B between two bases of a script that uses it as its word or line-break separator is orthographic, not a carrier, so it is preserved.
lao_zwsp.txt.summary: Lao prose using U+200B as its word separator.

latin1_text.txt.rule: Bytes that cannot be decoded as UTF-8 round-trip unchanged through surrogate escaping, so an undecodable file is never rewritten or mangled.
latin1_text.txt.summary: Latin-1 text whose accented bytes and no-break-space byte are not valid UTF-8.

myanmar_zwsp.txt.rule: U+200B between two bases of a script that uses it as its word or line-break separator is orthographic, not a carrier, so it is preserved.
myanmar_zwsp.txt.summary: Myanmar prose using U+200B as its word separator.

persian_frontmatter_values.md.rule: A joiner at the end of a text value is preserved, and the indentation and blank lines of a frontmatter block the Cleaner was not asked to touch stay exactly as they are.
persian_frontmatter_values.md.summary: Markdown frontmatter whose Persian scalar values end with a ZWNJ, including an indented list item.

persian_joiners.txt.rule: A zero-width joiner or non-joiner is orthographic in this script, so it is preserved wherever it sits, including at the end of a value and adjacent to punctuation, digits or a line break; the rule reads the neighbouring base character, never another carrier. The file also ends without a trailing newline, whose absence is preserved.
persian_joiners.txt.summary: Persian ZWNJ at every edge position Requirement 3.3 names, ending at end-of-file with no trailing newline.

thai_zwsp.txt.rule: U+200B between two bases of a script that uses it as its word or line-break separator is orthographic, not a carrier, so it is preserved.
thai_zwsp.txt.summary: Thai prose using U+200B as its word separator.

urdu_joiners.txt.rule: A zero-width joiner or non-joiner is orthographic in this script, so it is preserved wherever it sits, including at the end of a value and adjacent to punctuation, digits or a line break; the rule reads the neighbouring base character, never another carrier.
urdu_joiners.txt.summary: Urdu ZWNJ inside a compound greeting, before the Urdu full stop, beside extended Arabic-Indic digits and before a line break.
